items.title: City Teen Friends
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Explore the city with your teen friends and enjoy watching movies, listening to music, or playing your favorite game modes such as skyblock and parkour with style!

-12 skins
-By inPixel

items.title: Pro PVP Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Love PVP and fashion? Well, you're in luck! Join the pro PVP teens in playing game modes like skyblock and bedwars and show off your skills! Slay the ender dragon in style and prove you are a pro!

-9 cool skins
-by inPixel

items.title: Planets
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Survive and explore these planets by discovering the different biomes and secrets they contain!

- A fun challenge with lots of different environments to explore and secrets to discover! 
- To play alone or with others
- By inPixel & Evershapes

items.title: Camo Blocks: Nether
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Be the ultimate Nether ninja and hide from your friends with this Nether-themed camouflage set!

- 8 Nether camo blocks
- Roleplay as your favorite Minecraft blocks from the dreaded dimension!
- Perfect stealth mode textures
- Includes the following blocks: Crimson Stem, Magma Block, Nether Wart, Basalt, Obsidian, Warped Nylium, Warped Wart, and Netherrack

items.title: Geometry: Black & White
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Make a big impact with this abstract geometry skin set! With these modern geometric skins, you'll truly stand out!

- 8 unique skins!
- Wide variety of cool geometric patterns!
- Awesome gradients and geometries!

items.title: Glitched Teens
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These glitched teens are having trouble in the digital world! Something is going wrong with their textures, could this be the work of pro hackers?!

- 8 different skins!
- Each skin with a unique design, including pixel issues and missing textures!
- Wide variety of glitch effects!

items.title: Cozy Cliffhouse
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Zander Studios presents: Cozy Cliffhouse! Sit back, relax, and grab something to eat! Welcome to the Cozy Cliffhouse - explore the vast halls of the manor, or delve into the village below.

- Explore the Cozy Cliffhouse!
- Discover the village below!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Play with friends!
- Licensed by Zander Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Hackers vs Gods!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Top-level hackers face off against the almighty gods!
Grab this skin pack and become a high-tech neon hacker or a powerful elemental god!

+ 12 Hackers vs Gods skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes kitsune hackers and elemental gods!

items.title: Ghost Hunters
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
GHOSTS! GHOSTS EVERYWHERE!
Are you a real ghost hunter who's not even scared of a banshee or wraith?
Show your friends how scary or fearless you can be with this ghost hunters skin pack! Jump into the shoes of a scary ghost and scare people around you!

+ 10 TERRIFYING skins that send shivers down your spine!
+ 1 FREE skin: Spirit

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Roughlands
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description: A classic skyblock world where the resources generate rather than the land. Find all the generators and protect them at all costs.

items.title: Horror
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
These are the scariest skins around! Scare your friends with these scary horror styles!

- 12 horror skins
- Scare your friends!

items.title: Armor HD
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Armor HD is full of the coolest looking armor in Minecraft. Choose from 24 different armor skins. 

- 24 skins
- Power armor
- Great for parkour

items.title: Neko Emo
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Among us are the coolest styles in Minecraft. Show off your cool modern Neko style with this awesome skin pack. These modern styles are the coolest styles among us!

-Neko skins
-Modern style
-Emo style

items.title: Zombie Academy
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to zombie school! It's your first day here, and we are learning about braaaainsss! Be sure to be dressed appropriately.

+ 10 skins included
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Pajama Party
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Wear your pajamas and have a slumber party! Roleplay at a friend's house!

+ 10 sleep-wear themed skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.description: Are you a teen and love anime? Then you will love Anime Teens! Multiple skins to choose from!

items.title: Nether Mobs
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Become a mob from the nether! Roleplay as one of 10 different mob types!

+ 10 Nether mob styled skins!
+ Roleplay ready!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Black Fashion HD
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Decorate yourself with cute dark colored clothes! Wear these to the city and show off your fashion to everyone.

- Stylish anime themed clothes
-With various neko-mimi(Cat ears), patterned masks and sunglasses
-30 skins with 13 variations

items.title: PrestonPlayz Craftable Houses
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Craft your own adventure! Gather resources to instantly create over 20 builds including a roller coaster, castle, king of the hill, parkour gym, skywars arena, and more!

- 20 unique builds to craft
- Custom crafting recipes
- Custom terrain
- 10 included skins
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer
- Skyblock, skywars, king of the hill and more!

By CinemaCraft & Preston

items.title: Modern Teens Style
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Ready to be the hottest trend in the city? Then equip the latest fashion trends in the marketplace. Are you a teen that loves binge-watching anime all day? These teens do it as well! Parkour with these teens while expressing your anime spirit to your friends!

+ 12 modern fashion teens!
+ Anime addict teens!
+ Latest modern trend!
+ Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Luxury Modern Style
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to be the coolest teen in the city? Dress up with the latest fashion trends and the most luxurious brands while playing with your friends! The teens are ready to take over the city while playing parkour on their modern clothes.

+ 12 Luxury Modern Skins!
+ New modern fashion trend!
+ Perfect for city roleplay maps!

items.title: BLING! HD
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Ever wanted to live the rich life? Well now it's time to put on your jewelry and shine!

+ 10 HD teenage skins
+ The most trendy clothing
+ Lots of golden jewelry
+ 2 FREE skins!

items.title: Rainbow Lucky Blocks HD
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
If you're lucky, over the rainbow you'll find gold. So, imagine what a rainbow lucky block could bring! Dress up in an amazingly colorful rainbow lucky block themed skin and wow your friends. Great for mini games!

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Neon Demons HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Do you enjoy cyberpunk fashion or neon edgy styles? These inspired demon skins are for you! Comes with cool, colorful hairstyles and oddly geometrical clothing choices. Perfect for fantasy roleplay, scary maps, or daily survival game play with friends. 

+ 15 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna
